notes: 6th edition by count from 2002. 'TMT Trends 2007' separate Technology, Media and Telecommunications reports, each republished on Mondaq in two parts. Read: Technology Part One (4 sections), Media Part Two (1 section identified of 5), Telecommunications Part Two (4 sections). Not read: Technology Part Two, Media Part One, Telecommunications Part One. The four unidentified Media Part Two sections cover media pricing, social networking monetization, video on demand to PCs, and virtual worlds. Internet Archive retry (2026-10-02): all three reports read in full from deloitte.com/dtt/ copies on archive.org (ten chapters each, dated December 2006, released January 2007). Appended the chapters not yet captured: Technology 5 to 10 (entries 10 to 15), Media 1 to 5 and 7 to 10 (16 to 24; chapter 6 is the existing 'Analog apples and digital oranges'), Telecommunications 1 to 6 (25 to 30; chapters 7 to 10 are the existing entries). The four unidentified Media Part Two sections are chapters 7 to 10.
